summary: Publish SVG native charts only when declared appearance matches drawn primitives; preserve category order, point colours, labels and title in editable PPTX.
invariants: A mismatched declaration drops only its native annotation and retains the SVG drawing.
Horizontal bar categories render top to bottom in declared order.
Validated point colours, value labels, title spacing and line markers flow through the chart projection.
forbidden: Do not change raster deck slide XML for SVG chart appearance fixes.
